discharged: At a source level divisible by the prescribed residue prime, every nonzero original binary H1 eigensystem descends to a nonzero native H1 class for the actual diagonal character. The coefficient flag is invariant under the original group and Hecke actions; its exact sequences, finite H1, full Hecke commutativity, naturality and finite descent are proved. The quotient character is the actual lower diagonal entry to exponent e=n+(p-3)*j, with e+2*j congruent to n modulo p-1. Every original good-prime eigenvalue equals ell^j times the identity-coefficient character eigenvalue. Characteristics two and three are covered. The original primitive consumer supplies its nonzero binary H1 class using the existing local coefficient embedding. No surviving character piece, nonzero quotient class, exactness, commutativity, Hecke compatibility or exponent congruence is supplied.
